site.title: Rehan & Siddiqua
site.description: You are invited to the Nikah and Reception of Rehan and Siddiqua, 18 and 19 December 2026, Pune.

groom.name: Rehan
groom.parents: Son of Marhoom Mr. Mohd. Galib Kazi and Mrs. Shaheen Kazi

bride.name: Siddiqua
bride.parents: Daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Sarfaraz Ibrahim Shariff

wording.bismillahEnglish: In the Name of God, the Most Beneficent and the Most Merciful
wording.memorial: In loving memory of Marhoom Mr. Mohd. Galib Kazi and with the warm blessings of Mrs. Shaheen Kazi
wording.request: We cordially request the pleasure of your company, along with your family and friends, on the auspicious occasion of
wording.closing: We request the honour of your gracious presence and your blessings for the newlyweds on this joyous occasion.
wording.closingDuaArabic: بَارَكَ ٱللَّٰهُ لَكُمَا وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكُمَا وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
wording.closingDuaEnglish: May Allah bless you both, shower His blessings upon you, and unite you in goodness.
duaLines: May Allah bless your union and fill your home with mercy.
May your love be a source of peace, and your home a place of tranquillity.
May Allah unite you both in goodness, in this world and the next.
